_about: The COUNTY SERVERS list (src/net/net_browser.gd): the always-open lobbies the game shows and joins with one key. server/lobbies.json is what runs on them. The browser build joins through each one's "wss" (a secure WebSocket: a page on https may open nothing else). "relay": the party line (src/net/net_relay.gd) answers on that lobby's ports too; the game calls the first one marked.
